Various nattering that used to be on the page itself:

* '''''seltcana[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=seltcana ?]''''' network
* '''''lerseltcidu[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=lerseltcidu ?]''''' text
* '''''selsku[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=selsku ?]''''' content (text, images, sound)
* '''''velsku[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=velsku ?]''''' media, information channel (anything that conveys information)
* '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/skucripu skucripu]''''', '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/datnyterjo%27e datnyterjo'e]''''', '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/judrysni judrysni]''''', '''''sinxa[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=sinxa ?]''''', '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/pevyvro pevyvro]''''' hyperlink (n.)

** ''What's the place structure of '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/skucripu skucripu]'''''? How about [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/judrysni judrysni] or just plain sinxa[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=sinxa ?]?'' '''You can find the places of skucripu [http://www.balvi.org/stodi/balvi_valsi.jsp here][[Archivo:external_link.gif|15px|(external link)]]'''
** ''I think the key idea of the hyperlink is that it's a ''link,'' not simply a symbol. I suggest '''datnyvelgri''' for the actual link and '''judrysni''' for the link's symbol that appears on the page.''

* '''''vricyvelskuselnirna[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=vricyvelskuselnirna ?]''''', '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/balcukta balcukta]''''', '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/jondatnymu%27e jondatnymu'e]''''', '''''samrxuebe[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=samrxuebe ?]''''', '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/dikca+te+judri dikca te judri]''''' World Wide Web

** ''The inventor of the first term now prefers the metaphorical second suggested term. The coiner of the third term is distinct. The fourth term is a [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/fu%27ivla fu'ivla], and is also pretty common.''
** I dislike all of them. If you're going to use a short lujvo, at least use one that has ''something'' to do with the topic at hand, like '''''datnyci'e[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=datnyci%27e ?]''''' or something. Of the above, I hate '''''samrxuebe[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=samrxuebe ?]''''' the least, and '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/dikca+te+judri dikca te judri]''''' the most, with '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/balcukta balcukta]''''' a close second. I also like '''''la .ueb.[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=la+.ueb. ?]''''', because the web is a unique thing, IMO. — mi'e[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/Robin+Lee+Powell Robin Lee Powell]
** ''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/Mark+Shoulson I] had fun inventing '''ve'e vrici vreji''', which is slightly close to the English meaning. I think it should have '''la''', since it is a single thing.''

* '''''balckupau[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=balckupau ?]''''', '''''samrxuebe stuzi[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=samrxuebe+stuzi ?]''''', '''''[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/jondatnymu%27e+tcana jondatnymu'e tcana]''''' Web site
* '''''sezyskinoi[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=sezyskinoi ?]''''' Home page

** ''Actually '''''sezyskinoi[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=sezyskinoi ?]''''' is far broader in meaning than just 'home page'.''

* Software: '''''mutmi'i[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=mutmi%27i ?]''''', '''''mutca'a[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=mutca%27a ?]''''', '''''samselpla[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=samselpla ?]'''''

** '''''mutmi'i[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=mutmi%27i ?]''''' ''is good for "virtual machine" but can't describe all software. For example, a text editor cannot be a''minji'' because it's not automated.''

*** ''It's the word used by [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/GnomeNewWords GnomeNewWords], even for an editor (which it calls, specifically, '''datnygafmi'i'''). --pne''

**** Is that supposed to prove something? -Robin

** '''''samselpla[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=samselpla ?]''''' ''could mean a hardware design as well as a software design (which doesn't bother me).''

*** IMO, ''''samselpla[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-editpage.php?page=samselpla ?]'''' is code, not a running or runnable program. -Robin

** Here are the ones from the lujvo list. Note to self: having more than one lujvo is *OK*!

*** samru'e:skami+pruce:computer program [currently executing; process]:$pruce1 $pruce2 $pruce3 $pruce4 $skami1
*** samselpla:skami+se+platu:computer program [not necessarily executing; source code]:$platu2 $platu1 $platu3
*** samymidnoi:skami+minde+notci:computer program:$notci1 $notci2 $=minde3 $notci3 $=minde1 $notci4 $=skami1 $=minde2
*** samtermi'e:skami+te+minde:command line, computer instruction:$minde3 $minde2=$skami1 $minde1

<div>[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/tiki-view_forum_thread.php?forumId=1&comments_parentId=4786&comments_per_page=1&thread_style=commentStyle_plain Re: Lojban web-related terminology]</div><br></div><div><div>[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/user2 [[Archivo:avatar_rlpowell.jpg|rlpowell]]]Posted by [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/user2 rlpowell] on Mon 25 of July, 2005 18:32 GMT posts: 14214</div><div>
Not done with this yet; still need to add some of the old stuff back in.

joncku has not been added to jbovlaste yet; here's the suggested place structure.

c1=j1 is a web page/web site/presentation of hypertext/hypercard/hyperlinked/linked document(s) c2 created by author c3 for audience c4 in medium/website network c5 linked to document(s) j2 by hyperlink(s) j3

x2, x6 and x7 should be complete specifications, or end in li'o. Use fa'u for x6 and x7 to associate links with their destinations.

c5 could be dropped, but if it's left in then "ralju xe joncku" falls out as a term for the world wide web.

Getting to the x6 and x7 is a PitA, so for talking about hyperlinks I suggest "ckujo'e", which is just the above with the jorne places first.

-Robin
